In detail

The sector of the embassies, Herăstrău park and the Primăverii villas — and of Gara de Nord. Its coefficient has fallen hard, from 128.87 in 2023 to 103.17 in 2024 and 96.50 in 2025, now mid-table. The figures are the Bucharest Police's own published “coefficient of specific criminality” by sector, 2014-2025. The force does not state what the coefficient is per, so it is used here to compare sectors against each other and against their own past, which is what it supports, and not read as a rate per head. The amber is for the station and its immediate surroundings, which are crowded, transient and the one place in Bucharest where pickpocketing is a routine expectation — not for Herăstrău or Aviatorilor, which are among the calmest addresses in the city.

Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.
